{
  "issues": [
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_MOTOR_ROLE_MISSING",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule",
      "affected_entity_id": "ent_vesicle",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_MOTOR_DEPENDENT_TRANSPORT",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "MISSING_REQUIRED_ROLE",
      "required_evidence": "Task explicitly requires 'motor-protein-dependent' transport; evidence must name or describe a motor protein (e.g., kinesin, dynein) as an actor mediating vesicle movement along microtubules, or the task scope must be narrowed to exclude motor-protein dependence.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Add motor protein entity/role with separate evidence (kinesin/dynein, ATPase stepping) and cite a source supporting motor-protein-dependent vesicle transport along microtubules.",
        "Narrow model scope and title to 'microtubule-associated vesicle movement' and explicitly state motor-protein dependence as an unresolved limitation, not a modeled claim."
      ],
      "severity": "high",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "Retrieved passage E_9af4c0e6bde1 only states microtubules 'provide a track along which vesicles move'; it does not mention motor proteins, ATP dependence, or that vesicles themselves are the moving agents via motors. The model title claims motor-protein dependence but excludes motor-protein mechanism, creating a scope contradiction the evidence cannot support."
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_UNSUPPORTED_CAUSAL_VESICLE_MOVEMENT",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule",
      "affected_entity_id": "ent_vesicle",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_CAUSAL_MECHANISM",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "UNSUPPORTED_CAUSAL_CLAIM",
      "required_evidence": "Evidence explicitly stating that vesicles move along microtubules (as opposed to microtubules merely providing a track), and ideally the causal agent (motor protein) driving that movement.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Retrieve additional evidence naming vesicle movement along microtubules and the motor protein responsible.",
        "Reframe the process as a structural 'track availability' relation without asserting vesicle motion as an effect of microtubule presence alone."
      ],
      "severity": "high",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "The process types 'vesicle + microtubule → vesicle moves through cell', but the source only asserts microtubules provide a track; it does not state that vesicles move along it in a motor-dependent manner nor that vesicle presence plus track causes movement. The causal arrow is an inference beyond the passage."
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_OBSERVABLE_DETERMINISM_OVERREACH",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule",
      "affected_entity_id": "obs_vesicle_transport_relation",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_OBSERVABLE_FAITHFULNESS",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
      "required_evidence": "Source statements specifying that a particular vesicle is located on/moving along a microtubule at an observable time scale, with persistence/order semantics, to justify a DETERMINISTIC computational check.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Downgrade observable capability from DETERMINISTIC to a qualitative/generic relation without temporal persistence claims.",
        "Remove time-resolved observable and retain only the generic structural relation 'microtubule serves as track for vesicles'."
      ],
      "severity": "medium",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "Observable asserts 'serves_as_track_for' holds during transport as a DETERMINISTIC check, but the source makes only a generic statement; it does not entail vesicle-specific track occupancy at observable resolution."
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_TRACK_PROVISION_PROCESS_INFLATED",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_microtubule_track_provision",
      "affected_entity_id": "ent_microtubule",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_PROCESS_DISTINCTNESS",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
      "required_evidence": "Source describing a distinct process of 'track provision' with start/end conditions tied to vesicle movement, separate from the structural statement that microtubules provide a track.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Merge track provision into the transport process as a static precondition rather than a separate concurrent process.",
        "Remove temporal start/end and concurrent semantics; represent as a structural capability relation."
      ],
      "severity": "medium",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "The source contains one assertion that microtubules provide a track; modeling this as a separate process with concurrency and temporal conditions duplicates and inflates the single structural claim without independent evidence."
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_VESICLE_ENTITY_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule",
      "affected_entity_id": "ent_vesicle",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_ENTITY_IDENTITY",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "UNRESOLVED_SCIENTIFIC_IDENTITY",
      "required_evidence": "Source specifying vesicle type/identity (e.g., membrane-bound cargo carrier) or state transitions (moving/stationary) along microtubules.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Remove unsupported entity_type 'membrane-bound cargo carrier' and state definitions; retain only 'vesicle' as named in source.",
        "Retrieve additional evidence defining vesicle identity relevant to microtubule transport."
      ],
      "severity": "low",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "The source names 'vesicles' but does not define them as membrane-bound cargo carriers nor describe moving/stationary states along microtubules; the 'allow cytoplasm and vesicles to move' quote is cytoskeleton-level, not vesicle-specific microtubule transport."
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_SCOPE_TITLE_CONTRADICTION",
      "affected_process_id": "proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule",
      "affected_entity_id": "scope",
      "requirement_id": "REQ_SCOPE_EVIDENCE_ALIGNMENT",
      "evidence_ids": ["E_9af4c0e6bde1"],
      "issue_type": "SCOPE_MISMATCH",
      "required_evidence": "Either evidence supporting motor-protein-dependent transport, or a revised scope/title removing the motor-protein dependence claim.",
      "allowed_repair_actions": [
        "Retitle to 'Microtubule-associated vesicle movement' and update scope.included_processes accordingly.",
        "Add motor-protein evidence and include motor-protein mechanism in scope.included_processes."
      ],
      "severity": "high",
      "status": "open",
      "explanation": "Model title claims motor-protein-dependent transport while scope excludes motor-protein identity and mechanism; the single retrieved passage cannot support the title's central claim, making learner-facing framing misleading."
    }
  ],
  "requirements": [
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_MOTOR_DEPENDENT_TRANSPORT",
      "requirement": "Model must represent motor-protein-dependent vesicle transport along microtubules, or explicitly revise scope/title to remove motor-protein dependence and state it as unresolved.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule"]
    },
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_CAUSAL_MECHANISM",
      "requirement": "Causal claims in the process model must be directly supported by retrieved evidence, not inferred beyond it.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule", "proc_microtubule_track_provision"]
    },
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_OBSERVABLE_FAITHFULNESS",
      "requirement": "Observable constraints must not exceed the granularity and specificity of the source statements they cite.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule", "proc_microtubule_track_provision"]
    },
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_PROCESS_DISTINCTNESS",
      "requirement": "Each modeled process must correspond to a distinct source-supported process, not a paraphrase of a single structural assertion.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_microtubule_track_provision"]
    },
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_ENTITY_IDENTITY",
      "requirement": "Entity types, states, and roles must be supported by retrieved evidence or explicitly marked as unresolved.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule"]
    },
    {
      "requirement_id": "REQ_SCOPE_EVIDENCE_ALIGNMENT",
      "requirement": "Model title and scope must align with the evidence retrieved; unresolved aspects must be stated as limitations rather than claimed as modeled facts.",
      "covered_by_process_ids": ["proc_vesicle_transport_along_microtubule", "proc_microtubule_track_provision"]
    }
  ],
  "coverage_status": "REVIEW_INCOMPLETE"
}
